_help: site_url: public https origin without trailing slash (enables canonical/hreflang/sitemap). clean_urls: true links to folders (/hy/services/) for servers; false links to .../index.html so the site also works when opened from disk. base_path: sub-folder the site is served from (GitHub project pages: /GeoGeeks; empty for a domain root; only used by 404.html). tool_url: where the working shapefile->DXF converter lives (see README).
